- **[ML-T3-003](ML-T3-003-do-ensembles-cure-overfitting/README.md): Do Ensembles Cure Overfitting? A Bias-Variance Replication Study with Bagging and Boosting.** Build and validate a Monte Carlo bias-variance decomposition on a synthetic cocoa-yield problem with known truth, then use it to test whether bagging and boosting reduce variance, when boosting overfits, and how noise, sample size and irrelevant features change the answer.
